title: Исто́чники · Sources
model_authored_content: Drussky's original lessons, explanations and exercises were drafted with language models and edited by the project. The project reports Gemini 4 Argon and GPT (Codex) drafts for its original stories and mathematics material; those optional collections are not present in this audited resource snapshot. Claude (Anthropic) generates the live tutor's replies. This is a statement of creative process, not a claim of exclusively human authorship or a third-party content licence. Imported texts, recordings, reference material and fonts retain the separate rights and credits listed here.
rendering_note: Render attribution, source and licence links, changes, and font licence texts. Do not hide incomplete credit_status entries or display this manifest as legal clearance. foundation_audio is repository-only unless its asset is used by the app; ZIPA is conditional.
